name: quioteframework/filesystem-gcs
description: Google Cloud Storage filesystem adapter for Quiote — a Quiote\Filesystem\FilesystemAdapterInterface implementation for FilesystemManager, built on the GcsClient from quioteframework/session-gcs.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/filesystem-gcs/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
